title: KNAB will check if Saeima deputies are gaming the system on expenses
summary_full: Taking into account widespread public concern over the amount of housing and transportation compensation available to Saeima members, the Corruption Prevention and Combating Bureau (KNAB) will not only examine the validity of the housing compensation received by Saeima member Leila Rasima (Progressives), but will also assess other cases in which the members' declared place of residence or other circumstances may raise doubts, KNAB has confirmed to Latvian Radio.
